bear.reason: Value-trap case: the GLP-1 and Atkins declines prove secular; revenue falls past consensus; margin at about the worst clean year (FY2020, 9.58%); the multiple at the trough of the trading range (prior low 6.11x). METHOD — bear-state evidence: declining packaged-food comparables with clean income statements trade at 6.08x (INGR) to 8.57x (LW) on the lease-inclusive basis, so the recorded 7.0x sits inside the observed state while the market prices the name below it. Against the 14% normal the 10% margin retains 71%, milder than the weakest survivor's 63%; a retention-consistent bear near 8.8% still reads about 3.0 to 1. No quarter this fiscal year fell below the worst clean year.

base.reason: Revenue is consensus FY26E of 1,334, below management's reinstated $1.345-1.355B guide, so the base is conservative against their own path. METHOD — the normal margin is set between the seven-year clean median (15.5%) and the trailing clean margin through the third quarter (about 13.8%), deliberately nearer the trailing figure: this year's four-point gross-margin reset is treated as partly structural rather than fully temporary, after write-downs far larger than the single one the clean series originally excluded. At 14% the business recovers most — not all — of its historical profitability. The multiple sits below the 17.9x median of the 8.55-year range (35 quarterly closes); 12.5x is the 14th percentile, a durable discount for the unresolved category question.

bull.reason: The sell-off proves excessive: Quest carries growth and Atkins stabilizes at a smaller base; margin between the median and the best clean year (17.35%); the multiple moves toward but stays below the 17.85x median of the trading history (16.0x, about the 29th percentile).

revenue.method: Legs are set off the consensus path and the trailing-twelve-month base rather than round numbers: base is consensus FY26E, bull sits just under the trailing twelve months on a stabilizing Atkins, and bear takes revenue materially past consensus to price the secular decline case.

margin.method: The normal margin is set between the seven-year clean median and the trailing clean margin through the third quarter, nearer the trailing figure, treating part of this year's gross-margin reset as structural. The bear leg takes the worst clean year; the bull leg sits between the median and the best clean year.

verdict.rationale: WATCH at $10.53 — not held. The market prices this business below the cheapest multiple in its own trading history, on the view that GLP-1 drugs permanently shrink the snacking category. Our judgment is that the sell-off has overshot. The third quarter confirmed real damage — gross margin down four points and large write-downs — and we now treat part of that as permanent, at a 14% normal margin. Even so the grid reads 3.8 to 1 against our 2:1 bar, with cash generation near thirteen percent of market value. The case fails if the growth engine stalls two more quarters or October cuts guidance — Quest printed +1%, the open question; the October report is the next evidence.
reunderwrite_triggers: Quest revenue growth <= 0% YoY for two consecutive quarters — the growth engine is dead; re-underwrite the bull and base cases.
FY26 guidance cut at the fiscal Q4 print (~October 2026), or initial FY27 guidance below ~$1.30B — the base revenue path fails.

Gross margin below ~31% on a full-year basis, or a further decline beyond the ~4 points already absorbed — a margin regime break past what the 14% normal assumes. (The prior instance of this trigger fired on the nine-month decline and was discharged 2026-07-26 by the re-verification that re-set the normal; this is a fresh forward threshold.)
